s.t:
This is a company built for growth, not comfort.
When you join exmox, you’re stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field - solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone.
We build high-performing consumer products across multiple brands in one of the most competitive industries there is: mobile gaming. You will be part of a company that is on a path of hyper-growth, spearheading one of the largest innovations in the mobile gaming industry - a rewarded user engagement and user acquisition platform. We help mobile game publishers not only acquire new users, but also keep players engaged through rewarding experiences.
At exmox, engagement isn't an afterthought - it's one of our most important growth levers. Our reward apps (Testerup, Empfohlen, Testerheld) reach hundreds of thousands of active users, and increasing retention and customer lifetime value remains a major opportunity.
As our first Senior CRM Manager (m/f/x) , you will build this function from the ground up. You'll define the strategy, select and implement the CRM platform, design lifecycle journeys, and establish a culture of experimentation and optimization. Working closely with Product, Data, Engineering, and User Acquisition, you'll transform user insights into personalized experiences that drive activation, retention, re-engagement, and long-term value.
If you're excited by building from zero, combining strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and owning a growth function with direct business impact, this role offers the autonomy, visibility, and ownership to make a difference from day one, we want to hear from you.

Own the CRM platform end-to-end, including selection, implementation, and integration of user data across Testerup, Empfohlen, and Testerheld.
Define and execute the CRM strategy and channel roadmap across push, in-app, and email, translating business goals into measurable lifecycle initiatives.
Design, launch, and optimize lifecycle journeys across onboarding, retention, reactivation, and long-term value growth.
Build behavioral segmentation, personalization, and experimentation frameworks to deliver the right message to the right user at the right time.
Own CRM performance metrics (activation, retention, reactivation, ARPU, and LTV), using A/B testing and user insights to drive continuous improvement.
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and UA teams to ensure CRM is deeply integrated into the product experience and aligned with acquisition efforts.
Scale the CRM function from single-app engagement to cross-app lifecycle orchestration, leveraging advanced segmentation and predictive capabilities as the business grows.

Lifecycle journeys launch quickly: Onboarding, retention, and win-back programs are live within your first months, delivering personalized experiences across push, in-app, and email.
Retention and LTV measurably improve: Your lifecycle strategy drives meaningful gains in activation, retention, reactivation, ARPU, and LTV within your first two quarters.
CRM decisions are driven by data: Segmentation, experimentation, and performance reporting provide clear insights that guide lifecycle priorities and investment decisions.
Cross-functional teams are aligned around the user lifecycle: You partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and UA teams to create a seamless user journey and shared ownership of lifecycle KPIs.
You turn ambiguity into scalable systems: Through automation, testing, and process building, you establish CRM as a repeatable and scalable growth lever for the business.

Experienced: 5+ years of CRM experience, ideally within mobile apps, gaming, reward platforms, subscriptions, or app-first consumer businesses.
Expert: Hands-on experience implementing and managing CRM platforms, with expertise in audience segmentation, journey orchestration, personalization, and campaign automation. Experience with platforms such as Braze or OneSignal is a plus.
Data-Driven: Strong analytical mindset with experience measuring activation, retention, reactivation, ARPU, and LTV. Comfortable using data to identify opportunities, prioritize initiatives, and evaluate performance.
Experimentation-Focused: Proven track record designing and scaling lifecycle programs through A/B testing, user segmentation, and continuous optimization across push, in-app, and email channels.
Collaborative: Able to work effectively with Product, Engineering, Data, Design, and Marketing teams, translating user insights into impactful lifecycle strategies.
Work Approach: You thrive in an international, fast-paced environment and comfortable working with minimal direction in ambiguous situations.
What You Can Expect
Ambitious people, real ownership. You’ll work with driven, entrepreneurial people who care deeply about what they deliver, challenge each other openly, and own outcomes together.
We’re playing at the top, but we’re not done. Our apps rank in the top 5 of their categories. We’re determined to push further, compete harder, and earn the number one spot.
You own your own growth. Growth doesn’t happen by accident. At exmox, learning is built into the work - through responsibility, feedback, and real challenges.
Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great - but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the people, and the drive to win together.
Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

Wir sind eine kleine, wachsende Digitalagentur im Herzen von Köln und suchen ab sofort Verstärkung im Bereich Online Marketing . Für unsere Kunden decken wir die gesamte Bandbreite ab – von SEO über Paid Media bis hin zu strategischen Website-Relaunches. Wenn du Lust hast, Projekte aktiv mitzugestalten und mit uns zu wachsen, freuen wir uns auf dich!

In dieser Rolle bist du nicht nur strategischer Sparringspartner für unsere Kunden, sondern packst auch operativ mit an. Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für spannende Projekte und hast die Freiheit, Kampagnen von der ersten Idee bis zur finalen Umsetzung ganzheitlich zu gestalten:
Ganzheitliche operative Betreuung: Du bist nicht nur beratend tätig, sondern setzt Kampagnen im Online Marketing (z. B. SEO, Newsletter-Marketing) selbstständig auf, optimierst sie fortlaufend und hältst die Fäden in der Hand. Dabei hast du Spaß daran, dich auch in neue Kanäle einzuarbeiten.
Kundenberatung & Projektsteuerung: Du bist erste Ansprechperson für deine Kunden, berätst sie ehrlich auf Augenhöhe und steuerst deine Projekte eigenverantwortlich – vom Kick-off bis zum Reporting.
Trends & Innovation: Du hast ein Auge auf neue Werbeformen und bringst eigene Ideen direkt auf die Straße.
Qualifikation
Erfahrung im Digital Marketing: Du bringst mindestens 2–3 Jahre Praxiserfahrung im Online Marketing mit (Agenturerfahrung ist ein Plus!).
Keine Angst vor Zahlen: Du kannst Ergebnisse datengetrieben interpretieren und die richtigen Schlussfolgerungen daraus ziehen.
Kommunikationstalent: Du hast echte Freude am Austausch mit Kunden und daran, Projekte souverän und sympathisch zu begleiten.
Das richtige Allrounder-Mindset: Du bist neugierig, denkst lösungsorientiert und hast Lust, dich flexibel in neue Marketing-Disziplinen einzuarbeiten.

Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Gestalte deinen Arbeitstag so, wie er zu deinem Leben passt – dank Vertrauensarbeitszeit und Gleitzeit.
Zeit zum Durchatmen: Freue dich auf 30 Tage Urlaub im Jahr für deine Erholung.
Hybrid Work: Arbeite an bis zu drei Tagen pro Woche im Homeoffice. Die restlichen Tage verbringen wir in unserem zentralen Kölner Office.
Sport & Wellness : Wir fördern deine Fitness mit einer geförderten Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft.
Volle Mobilität: Mit dem Deutschlandticket bist du bundesweit flexibel und umweltfreundlich unterwegs.
Klingt nach deinem nächsten Karriereschritt?
Dann wollen wir dich unbedingt kennenlernen! Schicke einfach deine Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf, Gehaltswunsch und möglichem Startdatum an Jana.

Wer sind wir?
Entstanden sind wir aus Deutschlands größter Finanzbildungsorganisation. Über 250.000 jungen Menschen haben wir gezeigt, wie Finanzen wirklich funktionieren. Aus dieser Mission ist Finanzklar entstanden. Denn Wissen allein reicht nicht – die meisten Menschen scheitern nicht am Verstehen, sondern an der Umsetzung.
Genau hier setzen wir an: Wir helfen ganz konkret dabei, die richtigen Finanzentscheidungen zu treffen. Ohne Provisionslogik gegen den Kunden. Ohne undurchsichtige Produkte. Sondern mit echter, unabhängiger Beratung.
Unsere Mission: Gute Finanzentscheidungen dürfen nicht länger nur den Experten überlassen sein – wir demokratisieren sie.
Und dafür suchen wir dich. Als Media Buyer entscheidest du mit darüber, ob Menschen Finanzklar überhaupt kennenlernen. Wir suchen dafür jemanden, der nicht einfach Anzeigen schaltet, sondern versteht warum manche Kampagnen Menschen bewegen und andere nicht.
Aufgaben
Du planst, schaltest und optimierst unsere Meta-Ads-Kampagnen – von der Zielgruppe über das Budget bis zur täglichen Auswertung der Zahlen. Parallel entwickelst du die Creatives dazu: Anzeigenbilder, Videos und Texte, die unsere Botschaft transportieren. Du bringst zwei Dinge zusammen: Du analysierst Zahlen und verstehst, was sie bedeuten – und du entwickelst daraus Bilder und Texte, die Menschen wirklich ansprechen. Deine Aufgaben im Detail:
Eigenständige Planung, Aufbau und Steuerung von Meta Ads Kampagnen (Facebook & Instagram) – von der Strategie bis zur Umsetzung
Verwaltung und Optimierung von Werbebudgets mit klarem Fokus auf messbaren Ergebnissen (CPL, CTR, ROAS)
Entwicklung von Kampagnenstrategien auf Basis von Zielgruppenanalysen und Marktbeobachtung
Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Ad-Creatives – statisch und videobasiert – eigenständig oder in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team
Strukturiertes Testing von Zielgruppen, Creatives, Botschaften und Landingpages nach klarer Testlogik
Regelmäßige Analyse der Kampagnenergebnisse und Ableitung konkreter Optimierungsmaßnahmen
Erstellung verständlicher KPI-Reportings zur internen Auswertung und Weiterentwicklung der Strategie
Aktive Mitgestaltung der Gesamtmarketingstrategie von Finanzklar
Qualifikation
Stellenanforderungen – was du mitbringst

Analytisches Denkvermögen – du erkennst Muster in Zahlen, ziehst logische Schlüsse und kannst Daten in Entscheidungen übersetzen
Grundverständnis für digitales Marketing und Social Media – du weißt wie Plattformen wie Facebook und Instagram funktionieren
Affinität zu digitalen Tools und Systemen – neue Software erschließt du dir schnell und eigenständig
Erste Erfahrungen mit Meta Ads, Google Ads oder vergleichbaren Plattformen sind ein Plus – kein Muss
Meta Blueprint Zertifizierung von Vorteil – aber kein Ausschlusskriterium
Sauberes, fehlerfreies Deutsch in Wort und Schrift – Pflicht

Gespür für visuelle Wirkung – du erkennst was Menschen anspricht und was nicht
Fähigkeit, Werbebotschaften klar und zielgruppengerecht zu formulieren
Grundkenntnisse in Design- oder Videotools (z.B. Canva, Adobe Express, CapCut) von Vorteil – oder die Bereitschaft, sie zu erlernen
Interesse an Storytelling und der Frage warum bestimmte Inhalte funktionieren und andere nicht

Hohe Eigenmotivation – du treibst dich selbst an, auch wenn niemand nachfragt
Schnelle Auffassungsgabe und Lernbereitschaft – du bist bereit, in kurzer Zeit viel aufzunehmen und anzuwenden
Strukturierte und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise – du arbeitest präzise, dokumentierst sauber und hältst dich an definierte Prozesse
Offenheit für Feedback und Bereitschaft zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung
Teamfähigkeit – du arbeitest eng mit Geschäftsführung und Team zusammen und kommunizierst proaktiv
Vorerfahrung im Media Buying ist ein Plus – aber kein Muss. Entscheidend ist wer du als Mensch bist, nicht was auf deinem Lebenslauf steht.

Was du bekommst
Intensives Onboarding über ca. 6 Monate – du wirst hier wirklich aufgebaut, nicht ins kalte Wasser geworfen
Attraktives Fixgehalt plus variable Bonusvergütung bei Zielerreichung – dein Einsatz wird direkt belohnt
Einen Arbeitsplatz in einem Team das wächst, direkt kommuniziert und zusammenhält
Echte Entwicklungsperspektive: wer hier gut wird, übernimmt wachsende Budgetverantwortung und gestaltet die Marketingstrategie aktiv mit
Vollzeit oder Teilzeit – wir finden gemeinsam das Modell das passt
Ein Unternehmen mit echter Mission – du hilfst Menschen, bessere finanzielle Entscheidungen zu treffen

For decades, DTN has been the silent force behind some of the world’s most critical industries—helping businesses navigate complexity, uncertainty, and risk with smarter, faster decisions.

From agriculture to energy to weather intelligence, our proprietary Operational Decisioning Platform transforms raw data into decision-grade insights—enabling companies to optimize supply chains, ensure market stability, and safeguard infrastructure against disruption.

We don’t follow trends—we set the standard for precision, trust, and operational impact.
DTN is at an exciting inflection point. Building off a foundation of financial strength, profitability, and industry trust, we’re accelerating growth and expanding our global footprint. Our purpose-built solutions—powered by AI and honed by decades of vertical expertise—are helping some of the world’s most significant enterprises thrive amid operational constraints and uncover new opportunities in a fast-changing world.

DTN is seeking a Senior Product Marketing Manager to lead go-to-market strategy, positioning, messaging, and sales enablement for our Fuels Operations Hub solution. This high-impact individual contributor role will partner closely with Product Management, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to drive awareness, adoption, and growth across fuel distributors, petroleum marketers, and terminal operators.
The ideal candidate combines strong B2B SaaS product marketing expertise with a passion for market strategy, customer insights, and storytelling. You will play a critical role in translating complex operational workflows and market dynamics into compelling value propositions that drive measurable business outcomes.
What You Will Be Responsible For
Own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for Fuels Operations Hub, including market segmentation, ideal customer profile (ICP) development, launch planning, and competitive positioning
Partner with Product Management to influence roadmap priorities through market intelligence, customer insights, and competitive analysis
Lead product launches from planning through execution, coordinating efforts across Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing teams
Define, monitor, and communicate key GTM performance metrics including pipeline influence, win rates, competitive displacement, and sales cycle effectiveness
Develop differentiated positioning and messaging frameworks grounded in customer research, competitive intelligence, and DTN ’s unique data capabilities
Translate complex fuel operations workflows and pricing dynamics into clear, compelling value propositions for multiple buyer personas
Build and maintain messaging frameworks that scale across web content, sales collateral, campaigns, events, and outbound programs
Conduct ongoing customer and market research through win/loss analysis, customer interviews, prospect discovery, and advisory discussions
Own competitive intelligence efforts, including battle cards, competitor monitoring, and regular sales team briefings
Map buyer journeys and decision-making dynamics across key market segments
Develop and maintain sales enablement assets including pitch decks, one-pagers, ROI tools, competitive materials, objection-handling guides, demos, and sales plays
Deliver training and enablement programs that improve sales effectiveness and accelerate onboarding
Support strategic sales opportunities through customized content and direct engagement when needed
Contribute to thought leadership initiatives through webinars, case studies, industry events, analyst engagements, and market commentary
What You Will Bring to the Position
7+ years of product marketing experience within B2B SaaS, data, analytics, or technology companies in the oil and gas industry
At least 3 years of experience supporting complex enterprise buying processes and stakeholders
Proven success owning and executing go-to-market strategies from positioning and launch through measurement and optimization
Strong messaging, content development, and storytelling skills with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts
Experience building and scaling sales enablement programs that improve commercial effectiveness
Strong analytical skills with experience leveraging market sizing, pricing, pipeline, and performance data to inform decisions and strategy
Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and influence stakeholders without direct authority
Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills
What Will Make You Stand Out
Domain expertise within energy, fuels, commodities, agriculture, logistics, or adjacent industries
Experience marketing workflow software, operational platforms, or enterprise SaaS solutions
Familiarity with fuel pricing, terminal management, logistics, or fuel distribution operations
Experience presenting at industry conferences, webinars, or analyst briefings
Strong understanding of market dynamics impacting fuel marketers and distributors
What You Can Expect from DTN

Unlimited PTO
Flexible working hours
Remote work model (position dependent)
Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance Plans
6% 401K matching
Unlimited access to 13k+ courses via learning platform to support employee career advancement
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

The targeted hiring base pay range for this position is between $95,000 and $123,000 . DTN is a pay for performance organization, which means there is the opportunity to advance your compensation with performance over time.

The actual base pay offered for this position will be dependent upon many factors, including but not limited to: prior work experience, training/education, transferable skills, business needs, internal equity and applicable laws. The targeted hiring base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

This role may also be eligible for market competitive variable pay and benefits.

DTN is a global data and technology company helping operational leaders in energy, agriculture, and weather-driven industries make faster, smarter decisions. Our Operational Decisioning Platform turns complex data into decision-grade insights—empowering customers to expand their margins, accelerate growth, and outpace risk. With more than 1,200 employees globally, DTN serves the companies that feed, fuel, and protect the world.
At DTN , we value clarity, trust , and action . We’re a team of problem-solvers, outcome-drivers, and industry nerds who believe that precision matters – and that mission is at the core of what we do.
Trust Built: We earn it. We keep it. We protect it. Our neutrality, precision, and integrity are non-negotiable.
Confidence-Driven: We help customers move with clarity and conviction. We bring the data and operational knowledge leaders need to act.

Creative Strategist, Copywriter, Grafiker und Videografen im eigenen Haus. Kein Warten auf externe Zulieferer, dazu ein AI-Stack für mehr Output.

Product marketing at Mews is at a turning point. The function has been effective at launching products; what it has not yet built is the strategic layer that comes after launch – the continuous positioning, adoption strategy, and market intelligence that makes each product more valuable over time. This role owns that shift.
The Director of Product Marketing and Market Research is a combined senior leadership role responsible for two things that should never have been separated: how Mews brings products to market, and how Mews understands the market it operates in. You will lead the product marketing team, own the research and customer insights function, and serve as the go-to authority on both disciplines for senior leadership across the business.
Mews operates across property management, fintech and payments, guest experience, and marketplace. The right person for this role knows how to build a coherent positioning story across a complex multi-product portfolio – and how to ground that story in real market intelligence, customer insight, and competitive understanding rather than assumption.

Product marketing strategy
Define and own product marketing strategy across the Mews portfolio – covering positioning, messaging, and go-to-market execution from launch through adoption and ongoing engagement.
Build and govern the global product launch framework so that launches are scalable and repeatable, with clear handoffs between strategy and execution.
Own product adoption and post-launch engagement strategy – moving the function beyond launch execution to continuous market thinking that drives usage, retention, and revenue contribution.
Partner with Product, Sales, RevOps, and Customer Success to ensure product marketing strategy connects to commercial outcomes and is reflected in how the business goes to market.
Own NPS tracking programs and design the measurement framework for product marketing impact, including product attach rates, adoption metrics, and pipeline contribution.
Market research and customer insights
Own the end-to-end market research function: identifying research opportunities, designing methodology, running studies, synthesising findings, and activating insights across the business.
Lead primary and secondary research initiatives that inform strategic, commercial, and product decisions – including competitive analysis, customer behaviour, market sizing, and buyer intelligence.
Build competitive intelligence as a structured, ongoing discipline – not a one-off project. Translate competitive signals into positioning decisions, sales enablement, and product roadmap input.
Serve as the functional authority on what the market is telling Mews, and translate that into insight narratives that influence senior leadership decisions and business strategy.
Work closely with Strategy, Product, RevOps, and Marketing to ensure insights land where decisions get made, not just where they get read.
Team and function leadership
Lead and develop a team of product marketers, setting clear expectations, building capability, and creating a culture of commercial accountability.
Set the operating model for how the team works with AI – determining where AI handles execution tasks and where human judgment is irreplaceable, and building team-level standards accordingly.
Serve as the senior leadership go-to on product marketing and market intelligence – the person any executive can trust for a well-grounded, commercially-connected answer.
Represent product marketing and research in executive forums, contributing to annual planning and portfolio prioritisation decisions.

Professional knowledge and experience

Hi, we're the Findies team, and we're hiring our first dedicated Email Marketing Manager.
You'll own email end-to-end: picking and implementing the ESP, setting up deliverability foundations, and launching the lifecycle flows that turn one-time subscribers into retained, recurring revenue.
Reality check
This is a from-the-ground-up role in the truest sense — there is no existing playbook to inherit, no legacy flows to 'optimize,' no team to lean on. You'll be selecting the ESP, wiring up SPF/DKIM/DMARC yourself, and deciding what the first welcome email even looks like.

If you want a channel that's already humming and just needs incremental tweaks, this isn't that. But if you want to build a revenue channel from a blank page and see your name on every flow that exists a year from now, this is exactly that.

Select and own the ESP , collaborating with the development team on data integration (product/subscription) and deliverability setup.
Design and launch the foundational lifecycle flows: welcome/onboarding, Day 0–3 retention (cancel-prevention), cancellation/win-back, and transactional emails.
Run A/B tests on subject lines, content, timing, and segmentation, and turn results into action.
Build reporting that ties email directly to revenue: open rate, CTR, S1–S2 rebill rate, and % of total subscription revenue.
Collaborate with product, analytics, and design to turn user behavior and cohort data into targeted campaigns.
What makes you the perfect fit
2+ years of hands-on email/CRM/retention marketing experience: you've built a channel from scratch before, not just maintained one.
Practical ESP experience and a strong understanding of deliverability basics (including the principles of SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration)..
Strong grasp of A/B testing methodology and how to turn results into decisions.
Comfort with analytics tools (Amplitude/Mixpanel or similar) — you can read cohort and funnel data and know what to do with it.
Ownership mindset: you spot the bottleneck and go fix it, you don't wait for a brief.
Language: Ukrainian, Upper-Intermediate (B2+) English or higher.
What's in it for you
Build your own channel from zero: no inherited mess, no legacy flows — every automation, template, and testing roadmap in email will be yours.
Direct, measurable business impact: your flows move the needle on cancel rate and revenue from day one, and you'll see it in the numbers you report on.
A subscription product to sink your teeth into: real retention problems (S1–S2 rebill) instead of generic newsletter sends.
Full ownership, zero bureaucracy: you decide the ESP, the flow logic, the testing cadence — nobody hands you a predefined plan.
Room to grow: as the first person owning this channel, you're positioned to define — and later lead — email/CRM at Findies as it scales.

DeepL is at an inflection point in its growth, and this is an opportunity to shape how the world's most accurate AI translation company reaches and converts its highest-value accounts. This is a 12-month fixed-term contract covering maternity leave. As Performance Marketing Manager, you will own DeepL's global programmatic and account-based advertising programmes end to end, across EMEA, DACH, AMER and APJ for our Language AI, Voice and API product lines.
This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role. You'll step into a live programme with a seven-figure annual media budget, established DSP and ABM platform partnerships, and campaigns running across native, display, CTV, audio and DOOH.

Your job is to keep that engine running and improve it: sharpening targeting and creative, closing the gaps in attribution and CRM integration, managing our media and ABM partners, and working with Field, SDR and regional marketing teams to turn account engagement into pipeline.

Programmatic Campaign Execution
Build, launch and continuously optimize account-list and retargeting campaigns across programmatic native, display, CTV, audio and DOOH, spanning multiple products and regions.
Manage a substantial always-on media budget across markets, reallocating spend between products, channels and geographies based on performance rather than plan.
Own the campaign planning cycle and keep launches unblocked by chasing the account lists, landing pages and assets each one depends on.
Test creative, formats, targeting and channel mix, and act decisively on what the data shows — including pulling assets that underperform in-market.
Account-Based Marketing
Own our ABM platform as the internal expert, building personalised landing pages and microsites for named target accounts with tailored messaging, proof points and calls to action.
Run coordinated account plays that pair those personalised destinations with programmatic and paid social distribution, so accounts meet a consistent narrative wherever they encounter DeepL.
Get account-level engagement and buying signals into the hands of Field and SDR teams quickly enough to act on, and drive adoption of the capabilities we're paying for but not yet using.
Define and expand target account lists with Field, SDR and regional marketing, and get regional plays approved and live.
Agency, Vendor & Martech
Own the day-to-day relationship with our DSP and ABM platform partners: clear briefs, KPI accountability, budget efficiency and creative production timelines.
Pick up and run the media agency selection process, evaluating shortlisted partners across strategy, media management and measurement, and making a costed recommendation to leadership.
Lead the evaluation of new ABM and intent technologies, running discovery and pilots and recommending whether to proceed. Several conversations are already in flight for you to take forward or close out.
Oversee platform integrations with CRM and marketing automation, working with Marketing Operations and internal engineering to see open tickets through.
Measurement & Enablement
Own performance reporting across the programme by product, channel and region, and communicate it clearly to Marketing and Field leadership.
Close the known gaps in programmatic measurement. Attribution currently relies on UTMs, which under-reports a predominantly view-through channel; you'll help land log-level data ingestion and account scoring with our DSP partner and internal data teams.
Build the playbooks, templates and channel guidance that let regional marketers run account-based plays in their own markets, making the programme repeatable rather than dependent on you alone.
Leave the programme documented, measurable and handover-ready.

4–7+ years in B2B performance or account-based marketing, ideally in enterprise or B2B SaaS, with hands-on ownership of paid campaigns rather than oversight of others running them.
Deep, practical experience with programmatic advertising — DSP campaign setup, account-list targeting, retargeting, budget pacing and optimisation across native, display, CTV and audio.
Experience running an ABM platform or personalisation tooling, and using engagement signals to support sales outreach.
Comfort managing meaningful media budgets across multiple markets, and making reallocation decisions with incomplete information.
Strong vendor and agency management skills: briefing, holding partners to KPIs, running evaluations or RFPs, and negotiating scope and cost.
Genuine fluency with measurement — you understand the limits of UTM-based attribution for view-through channels and can work constructively with data teams.
A track record of partnering closely with Field and SDR teams, and of building frameworks other marketers can pick up and run with.
Strong project management and communication skills, with the ability to run many concurrent campaigns across regions and prioritise without heavy oversight.
A builder's mindset, comfortable operating without a team beneath you — this is a role for someone who wants to own outcomes directly.

Kleines Kraftwerk & Du Wir sind Kleines Kraftwerk, ein junges Unternehmen mit großer Ambition.
In nur drei Jahren sind wir stark gewachsen und noch lange nicht am Ziel. Bei uns erwarten dich Verantwortung, Tempo und echter Gestaltungsspielraum – verbunden mit der Erwartung, dass du ihn nutzt. Mit unseren Produkten bringen wir die Energie von morgen direkt zu den Menschen nach Hause. Unsere Mission ist es, nachhaltige Energie einfach, zugänglich und alltagstauglich zu machen.
Du sorgst dafür, dass die richtige Botschaft zur richtigen Zeit bei den richtigen Kund:innen ankommt und machst sichtbar, welchen Beitrag CRM zu unserem Wachstum leistet.
Als unser:e neue:r
Senior CRM Manager:in / Lifecycle & Retention entwickelst du CRM bei uns von einem bislang nebenbei betriebenen Kanal zu einer echten Wachstumsfunktion. Die Basis ist da: Klaviyo, mehrere hunderttausend Leads und Kund:innen sowie jede Menge Daten. Was fehlt, ist eine klare CRM-Strategie mit intelligenter Segmentierung, automatisierten Lifecycle-Flows, strukturiertem Testing und einem Reporting, das Wirkung und Umsatzbeitrag sichtbar macht.
Du verschickst bei uns also nicht einfach Newsletter. Du gestaltest, wie wir entlang des gesamten Lifecycles Kund:innen ansprechen und langfristig binden. Dafür bekommst du echte Ownership, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und die Chance, CRM bei Kleines Kraftwerk von Grund auf zu prägen.
Bereit, aus CRM einen echten Wachstumstreiber zu machen?
Wofür du Verantwortung übernimmst
CRM lief bei uns bisher nebenbei – jetzt wollen wir daraus einen echten Wachstumstreiber machen.
Du baust unsere CRM- und Lifecycle-Strategie auf: Du entwickelst Prozesse, Tools und Strukturen von Grund auf und richtest sie auf Kundenbindung und Wiederkäufe aus.
Du entwickelst unsere Lifecycle-Flows: In Klaviyo konzipierst und optimierst du automatisierte Customer Journeys von Welcome und Post-Purchase bis Cross-/Upselling und Win-back.
Du entwickelst relevante Kundensegmente: Leads und Kund:innen segmentierst du nach Kaufverhalten, Interessen und Lifecycle-Phase für eine gezielte Kundenansprache.
Du verantwortest unsere CRM-Kampagnen: Du steuerst Themen, Timing und Versand und stimmst dich eng mit Marketing und E-Commerce ab.
Du etablierst eine Test- und Lernkultur: Mit strukturierten A/B-Tests identifizierst du Optimierungspotenziale und entwickelst unsere CRM-Maßnahmen kontinuierlich weiter.
Du steuerst die CRM-Performance: Relevante KPIs und Reportings nutzt du, um Erfolge messbar zu machen und konkrete Maßnahmen abzuleiten.
Du stellst Datenqualität und Compliance sicher: Du sorgst für sauberes Listenmanagement und DSGVO-konforme CRM-Prozesse.
Du identifizierst die größten CRM-Hebel: Potenziale priorisierst du nach Business Impact und entwickelst perspektivisch weitere Retention-Programme wie Loyalty und Referral.
Womit du punkten kannst Du kennst CRM nicht nur aus der Theorie. Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im CRM-, Lifecycle- oder Retention-Marketing mit und weißt, wie aus Kundendaten relevante Kommunikation und messbare Kundenbindung entsteht. Dabei wartest du nicht auf Vorgaben, sondern erkennst Potenziale und setzt sie eigenständig um.
Du kennst CRM aus der Praxis: Du bringst ca. 4+ Jahre Erfahrung mit, idealerweise im E-Commerce- oder D2C-Umfeld, und hast eine CRM-Funktion bereits aufgebaut oder maßgeblich weiterentwickelt.
Du beherrschst Klaviyo: Flows, Segmentierung, Templates und Testing gehören für dich zum Tagesgeschäft und auch mit großen Kontaktdatenbanken arbeitest du sicher.
Du denkst datengetrieben: Du verstehst relevante CRM-KPIs, erkennst Zusammenhänge und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen zur Steigerung von Kundenbindung und Umsatz ab.
Du behältst den Überblick und setzt Prioritäten: Kampagnen, Flows, Tests und neue Ideen gleichzeitig bringen dich nicht aus dem Takt. Du entscheidest eigenständig, wo der größte Hebel liegt.
Du willst gestalten statt verwalten: Du hast den Anspruch, CRM aktiv aufzubauen, Strukturen zu schaffen und bestehende Ansätze kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.
Du kommunizierst souverän: Du arbeitest eng mit unterschiedlichen Teams zusammen und kannst dich auf Deutsch sehr sicher und klar verständigen.

du lange Freigabeprozesse einer schnellen, direkten Abstimmung mit der Geschäftsführung vorziehst.
du ausschließlich Kampagnen versenden möchtest, ohne Verantwortung für Segmentierung, Testing und Reporting zu übernehmen.

Du studierst aktuell — idealerweise etwas in Richtung Marketing, Kommunikation, Medien, Eventmanagement oder BWL, aber der Studiengang ist uns weniger wichtig als das, was du drauf hast.

5+ years buying Google Ads, and you can prove it. Genuine multi-account experience. Be ready to walk us through real accounts: what was wrong, what you changed, why, and what happened next. Running one large account well is a different skill and it is not this one.
Lead-gen and local service first. Most of the book is graded on cost per qualified phone call, not ROAS. If ROAS and shopping feeds are all you have done, this is a harder fit.
Sound judgment on small samples. You know why "40 clicks, no conversions" is usually not a reason to pause anything, and you can explain what would change your mind.
You can explain a bidding strategy, not just set one. Target CPA and target ROAS, and what happens when a target is too tight versus too loose.
You understand offline conversion imports. Why Google Ads and a client's booking system disagree, and which one you optimize against.
Call tracking experience, CallRail preferred. Every account here is graded on tracked phone calls, so the call data is the scoreboard, not a side report.
You already work with AI and you want more of it. This is not a culture question, it is the job. We use Claude and Claude Code every day and you would too. Not an engineer: someone who reaches for these tools by instinct and can say what they have actually built with them.
You think in portfolios. Forty accounts is not forty craft projects. What works has to be systematized, not hand-tuned shop by shop.
Very fluent English, spoken and written. Hard requirement, no exceptions. You will interview shop owners and explain technical findings to non-technical people. We test this on a live call, not from a CV.
Willing to say "I do not know yet, let me check." Our worst outcomes have all come from confident wrong answers.
No certifications needed. Not a fit if you want to own client relationships, or want part-time alongside other retainers.
Read this part first, because it is what makes the job unusual: this is not one big account. It is twenty to forty small ones. A typical shop spends $1,000 to $4,000 a month. The largest spends about $7,800.
At those budgets you rarely have enough data to test your way to an answer. Forty clicks and no conversion is not evidence that a keyword is dead. Most of this job is making sound decisions on thin data, at volume, without fooling yourself. If your experience is one large account where you could run a clean experiment every fortnight, this will be an uncomfortable fit and we would rather you knew now.
You will not be an account manager. We are hiring one of those separately. No monthly review calls, no chasing invoices. You own performance.

Performance across the whole book. Campaign structure, bidding strategy, budget allocation, negative keywords, and knowing when to scale versus protect.
The decisions the system escalates. Twice a week you work a board of flagged items and rule on them. Early on you stage those rulings for review; once you have earned it, you rule and we read the log.
Measurement. Conversion tracking, GA4 and GTM, call tracking, offline conversion imports. When the numbers look wrong you find out why before anyone changes a bid.
Technical discovery for new shops. You interview the owner about what they do and do not do, their service radius, their seasonality. That produces the service definition our automation runs on.
